# choco CLI reference

`ModularPipelines.Chocolatey` provides strongly typed access to the `choco` CLI.

## Executable prerequisite

This package does not install the `choco` executable. Install it separately and ensure `choco` is available on `PATH`.

Follow the executable's official documentation for installation instructions.

## Package installation

```shell
dotnet add package ModularPipelines.Chocolatey
```

Resolve the service with `context.Tools.Choco`.
Projects using C# 13 or another .NET language can use `context.Tools.Get<ModularPipelines.Chocolatey.Services.IChoco>()` instead.

## Module example

Resolve the service in a module, then select a command from the table below. A runnable example is omitted when no command has complete safety metadata:

```csharp
var choco = context.Tools.Choco;
```

## Global options

Global options are rendered after the selected subcommand.

| CLI option | Property | Availability | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--acceptlicense` | `Acceptlicense` | All editions | AcceptLicense - Accept license dialogs automatically. Reserved for future use. |
| `--allowunofficial` | `Allowunofficial` | All editions | AllowUnofficialBuild - When not using the official build you must set this flag for choco to continue. |
| `--cache` | `Cache` | All editions | CacheLocation - Location for download cache, defaults to %TEMP% or value in chocolatey.config file. |
| `--debug` | `Debug` | All editions | Debug - Show debug messaging. |
| `--failstderr` | `Failstderr` | All editions | FailOnStandardError - Fail on standard error output (stderr), typically received when running external commands during install providers. This overrides the feature failOnStandardError. |
| `--force` | `Force` | All editions | Force - force the behavior. Do not use force during normal operation - it subverts some of the smart behavior for commands. |
| `--ignore-http-cache` | `IgnoreHttpCache` | All editions | Ignore any HTTP caches that have previously been created when querying sources, and create new caches. Available in 2.1.0+ |
| `--include-headers` | `IncludeHeaders` | All editions | Include header names when --limit-output is used. Requires Chocolatey CLI 2.5.0+ |
| `--limitoutput` | `Limitoutput` | All editions | LimitOutput - Limit the output to essential information |
| `--log-file` | `LogFile` | All editions | Log File to output to in addition to regular loggers. |
| `--no-progress` | `NoProgress` | All editions | Do Not Show Progress - Do not show download progress percentages. |
| `--nocolor` | `Nocolor` | All editions | No Color - Do not show colorization in logging output. This overrides the feature 'logWithoutColor', set to 'False'. |
| `--noop` | `Noop` | All editions | NoOp / WhatIf - Don't actually do anything. |
| `--proxy` | `Proxy` | All editions | Proxy Location - Explicit proxy location. Overrides the default proxy location of ''. |
| `--proxy-bypass-list` | `ProxyBypassList` | All editions | ProxyBypassList - Comma separated list of regex locations to bypass on proxy. Requires explicit proxy (`--proxy` or config setting). Overrides the default proxy bypass list of ''. |
| `--proxy-bypass-on-local` | `ProxyBypassOnLocal` | All editions | Proxy Bypass On Local - Bypass proxy for local connections. Requires explicit proxy (`--proxy` or config setting). Overrides the default proxy bypass on local setting of 'True'. |
| `--proxy-password` | `ProxyPassword` | All editions | Proxy Password - Explicit proxy password (optional) to be used with user name. Encrypted. Requires explicit proxy (`--proxy` or config setting) and user name (`--proxy-user` or config setting).  Overrides the default proxy password. |
| `--proxy-user` | `ProxyUser` | All editions | Proxy User Name - Explicit proxy user (optional). Requires explicit proxy (`--proxy` or config setting). Overrides the default proxy user of ''. |
| `--skipcompatibilitychecks` | `Skipcompatibilitychecks` | All editions | SkipCompatibilityChecks - Prevent warnings being shown before and after command execution when a runtime compatibility problem is found between the version of Chocolatey and the Chocolatey Licensed Extension. |
| `--timeout` | `Timeout` | All editions | CommandExecutionTimeout (in seconds) - The time to allow a command to finish before timing out. Overrides the default execution timeout in the configuration of 2700 seconds. Supply '0' to disable the timeout. |
| `--trace` | `Trace` | All editions | Trace - Show trace messaging. Very, very verbose trace messaging. Avoid except when needing super low-level .NET Framework debugging. |
| `--use-system-powershell` | `UseSystemPowershell` | All editions | UseSystemPowerShell - Execute PowerShell using an external process instead of the built-in PowerShell host. Should only be used when internal host is failing. |
| `--verbose` | `Verbose` | All editions | Verbose - Show verbose messaging. Very verbose messaging, avoid using under normal circumstances. |
| `--yes` | `Yes` | All editions | Confirm all prompts - Chooses affirmative answer instead of prompting. Implies --accept-license |
